name: Pacific Missile Range Facility Barking Sands
tagline: The Navy's missile test range on the west side of Kauai, with a small family community near Kekaha.
coords_source: approximate point on the installation, from public maps
_note: Written on 2026-11-21 by scripts/guides/write_missed_guides.py from the official pages named in each section. Not in the first installation list; added after the missed-bases check.

data.Location: Kekaha, west side of Kauai, Hawaii
data.Size: The State of Hawaii names it the third largest employer on Kauai, with nearly 1,000 defense personnel and contractors.

source.label: Hawaii Defense Economy, Pacific Missile Range Facility

sections.title: Housing
data: Accompanied service members can live in Navy public-private venture family housing on the installation or rent in the local community. The Navy Housing Service Center is in Building 1261 on Tartar Drive.
Unaccompanied housing is on Nohili Road.

sections.title: Schools
data: There is no DoDEA school on Kauai. Children attend Hawaii public schools; the installation's welcome packet names Kekaha Elementary School nearby and notes school bus service for family housing.
The packet is older, so confirm current schools and bus routes with the Hawaii State Department of Education and the installation's school liaison.

source.label: Welcome to the Pacific Missile Range Facility (welcome packet, older)

sections.title: Medical care
data: The installation's welcome packet says a base corpsman gives limited routine care to active duty members. Family members use civilian doctors on Kauai under TRICARE Prime Remote.
Confirm current medical support with the installation before you move.

source.label: Welcome to the Pacific Missile Range Facility (welcome packet, older)

sections.title: Getting here
data: PMRF is on the west side of Kauai near Kekaha. The installation guide's Getting Here page describes the route from Lihue Airport.
